Mock bank

This stands in for bank identification on a developer's machine. Nobody here is a person: every code on this page is artificial.

Newcomers

Never seen by Kuutti before the first login.

People with a history

The same identity on every day. What Kuutti holds about them is given by pnpm demo:reset; before it has run they are newcomers too.

Ages

Born relative to today, so the age holds whenever this runs and the identity changes as the months pass.

Somebody else

The claims go into the ID token as they are. Use generated codes only, never a person's.
